listen_lan.title: LAN access
listen_lan.description: Open TCP 3310 in the node firewall (public zone) so clients outside the cluster can use the scanner. Loopback and the cluster VPN are always allowed.

max_file_size_mb.title: Maximum file size (MB)
max_file_size_mb.description: Files larger than this are not scanned (clamd MaxFileSize).

max_scan_size_mb.title: Maximum scan size (MB)
max_scan_size_mb.description: Maximum amount of data scanned per file, including unpacked archive contents (clamd MaxScanSize).

stream_max_length_mb.title: Maximum stream length (MB)
stream_max_length_mb.description: Largest file a client may stream to the daemon (clamd StreamMaxLength). Must not be smaller than the maximum file size; match it with the client's limit (e.g. Nextcloud's 'maximum stream length').

signature_checks_per_day.title: Signature update checks per day
signature_checks_per_day.description: How often freshclam checks for new signature databases.
